analysis: The change is confined to the test file provider-swift/Tests/ProviderCoreTests/Server/NemotronSuperLocalHTTPTests.swift. In head it edits a doc comment (lines 221-225) and simplifies the body(images:) helper at lines 251-252. It drops the unused `text` parameter and the over-8-MiB-encoded-body refusal case. The comment says that bound is unreachable because the upload limit answers 413 first, and the existing test at lines 148-155 covers 413 with localInferenceMaxUploadBytes+1. I examined the whole file. The tests use synthetic tokens and loopback 127.0.0.1 with port 0. They assert 401 before acquire, that a hook-less app falls back to non-OK, that malformed or remote-URL images get 400 without fetching, and that reservations are released. The test-only reset socket and terminal gate do not ship in production code. I found no production code, auth, crypto, attestation or coordinator-protocol changes. The removed test case duplicated coverage from the upload-limit test, so there is no security regression. No threat-model assumptions are invalidated. The one remaining question is whether the production upload-limit enforcement in the local inference server is unchanged, which is outside this batch. That is a coverage limit, not a finding.
